message: The other day, my friend Carol called me in a bit of a tizzy. She had just watched a documentary about emergency preparedness and was convinced we needed to build a bunker in her backyard! 😅 I reminded her that while it's great to be prepared, we can take small, practical steps instead. We spent an afternoon creating our go-bags together, chatting about what to include, and it turned into a lovely bonding experience. Sometimes, just having a plan in place can ease those panicky feelings, don’t you think?
